CHIEF COMPLAINT
Positive Hepatitis C test

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Asymptomatic patient with positive Hepatitis C serology discovered on routine screening during recent physical examination. Patient reports feeling well and denies any prior diagnosis of Hepatitis C. Finding was unexpected to the patient.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Not discussed.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
No other significant medical conditions reported. Patient reports being in good health otherwise.

MEDICATIONS
Denies current medications.

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
High blood pressure, diabetes, and depression

SOCIAL HISTORY
History of intravenous drug use; patient reports being clean for over 15 years. Alcohol: currently drinks beer approximately one per day, markedly reduced from heavier use in the past. Tobacco: currently smokes 1-2 cigarettes per day, has significantly decreased from prior use but reports difficulty with complete cessation.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vitals: Within normal limits
General: No distress, no jaundice
Cardiac: Regular rate and rhythm with grade 2/6 systolic ejection murmur
Pulmonary: Clear lungs without wheezes, rales, or rhonchi
Abdomen: Bowel sounds present, soft, no hepatosplenomegaly
Musculoskeletal/Neurological: No gait disturbance, no edema

RESULTS
HCV Antibody: Positive
Liver Panel:
- AST: Elevated at 39
- ALT: Within normal limits
- Albumin: Within normal limits
- Total bilirubin: Within normal limits

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Hepatitis C infection confirmed by positive HCV antibody. Patient likely has had chronic infection for several years; most patients remain asymptomatic until years after infection. Additional testing to confirm diagnosis and assess severity: HCV RNA, HCV genotype, and liver ultrasound with elastography to assess for fibrosis. Family screening recommended for wife and children with HCV antibody testing; will coordinate appointments with family doctor. Counseling provided regarding smoking cessation and alcohol reduction. Follow-up in 3 weeks to review results of additional testing and determine treatment plan.
